message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) resulted in heavy losses on both sides. Roughly:

| Side | Casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|----------------------------------------|
| French | ~25 000 |
| Allied (British, Dutch, Belgian, Prussian) | ~22 000 |

So the combined total was about **47 000** casualties.
